description: Four pulse generators, each firing a pulse of a set length on the rising edge of its input.

params.text: Sets the length of the pulse from that generator, 10 microseconds to 100 seconds, with a default of 10ms.

inputs.text: A rising edge here fires a pulse from that generator.

outputs.text: Carries the digital high voltage for the length set for that generator, starting on the rising edge of its input, and the low voltage the rest of the time.

menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
